## Supporting Public Health and Donor-Funded Programmes

GPD supports procurement teams and authorised importers working with donor-funded health initiatives
across Africa. Our regulated, GDP-compliant facility is set up to prepare both routine and urgent
consignments to the same standard. Whether the brief is a single tender or a multi-country project,
we keep the paperwork tight and stay calm under pressure. We work through authorised importers
rather than into any programme directly, which keeps responsibilities clear.

## Supporting Public Sector and NGO Programmes

Many of our largest projects are public. We work with government buyers, donor-funded programmes,
and NGOs running national health efforts across multiple countries. They come to us for full
programme deliveries, bundled medical kits, and time-sensitive stock that needs to move without
error.

We support these operations through a regulated 8,000 sq ft warehouse near Heathrow, giving us the
infrastructure to handle both routine fulfilment and urgent deployments.

There’s no need for detail here. Just know we’re prepared for the scale, and we take it seriously.

## A Business Built on Trust

You won’t see us in splashy ads. Most of our clients found us through someone who said,
***“Talk to these people, they get it done.”***

We’ve been featured in Forbes, Business Insider, and International Business Times, but our real
reputation is built off-the-record. After the first order, most clients don’t switch. That’s the
kind of growth we’re proud of. We don’t need managing. We just need the brief.

## Expanding Where It Matters

Buyers asked us for more than supply, so we built advisory support around what they were already
doing. Today GPD supports procurement forecasting, demand mapping, and export documentation for
cross-border orders. We don’t consult to teach; we consult to enable faster, compliant operations.

We believe in making life easier for the person at the other end of the email.

That means:
* Clear responses, not delays
* Paperwork that’s right the first time
* Reliable scheduling
* Early warnings, if needed
* Support when it’s useful, and space when it’s not

Being a GDP-compliant pharma exporter isn’t a badge. It’s a way of showing up properly every day.

## Steady, Ready, and Focused on the Work That Matters

Healthcare systems face constant change. Regulations shift, costs rise, but our focus stays steady.
Every shipment leaves our MHRA-licensed facility under verified GDP control, and every record is
kept so it can be checked later. We don’t just handle medicines; we protect the systems that rely on
them.

## Frequently Asked Questions

## What is Global Pharma Distributor?

Global Pharma Distributor (GPD) is an MHRA-licensed pharmaceutical wholesaler based in the United
Kingdom. From a regulated UK facility, GPD prepares GDP-compliant medicines and medical supplies for
licensed importers, government health ministries, and NGO programmes worldwide, supported by
temperature-controlled storage, batch verification, and documented export records.

## Is GPD MHRA licensed?

Yes. GPD holds a Wholesale Dealer Authorisation (Human), or WDA(H), issued by the UK Medicines and
Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA). It allows GPD to procure, hold, and export human
medicines to other businesses under GDP, with a designated Responsible Person accountable for
compliance. Export documentation, batch records, and temperature logs are kept in line with MHRA
requirements.

## Which regions does GPD export to?

GPD supports authorised importers across Africa and the Middle East, working with licensed partners
under their own national regulators. Each shipment is prepared with MHRA-backed documentation and
GDP-aligned handling suited to institutional procurement and regulated import processes. For
regional detail, see the Middle East pharmaceutical exports hub.

## Does GPD supply NGOs and donor-funded health programmes?

GPD supports procurement teams and authorised importers connected to NGOs and donor-funded health
initiatives. It prepares verified medicines and medical supplies for buyers working within global
health frameworks, and provides the export documentation and temperature records those programmes
rely on for accountability. GPD works through authorised importers and makes no claim of direct
programme affiliation.

## How does GPD maintain temperature control during pharmaceutical exports?

GPD maintains temperature-controlled storage at its regulated UK facility, where
temperature-sensitive products are held in monitored conditions and packed with calibrated
monitoring devices. For international transit, temperature-controlled handling is coordinated
through validated logistics partners working to GDP frameworks. Each consignment carries documented
temperature records that support regulatory review and buyer verification.

## What products does GPD distribute?

GPD handles branded pharmaceuticals, generic medicines, over-the-counter products, medical devices,
and medical supply kits. Categories can include essential medicines, antiretrovirals, antimalarials,
temperature-sensitive vaccines, and hospital consumables. Everything is sourced from approved UK and
European suppliers under GPD’s wholesale dealer authorisation.

## Where is GPD's warehouse located?

GPD operates from a regulated pharmaceutical facility near London Heathrow Airport, set up for
temperature-controlled storage and export preparation under GDP standards. The Heathrow location
helps GPD coordinate international freight efficiently for the licensed importers it serves.

## Does GPD provide procurement consulting support?

Yes. Alongside supply, GPD offers operational support such as product sourcing guidance,
documentation preparation, and logistics coordination for cross-border orders. These services help
licensed importers and institutional buyers manage regulated supply chains with fewer gaps.

## How can licensed importers request a quotation?

Licensed importers, government procurement offices, and NGO programme managers can contact GPD’s
compliance team for export documentation or a quotation. Enquiries are handled in line with GPD’s
MHRA obligations and confidentiality procedures, and qualified enquiries receive a response with
preliminary documentation guidance.

One-Stop-Partner für aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für Ihre flüssigen Produkte. Neben unseren
leistungs­starken bottelpack Abfüllanlagen bieten wir Lohnabfüll­dienst­leistungen, Unterstützung bei
der Produkt­entwicklung sowie ein umfassendes Service­angebot für alle Ihre Verpackungs­anforderungen.

Technologie

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

Produktionsspitzen abdecken oder Marktchargen vollständig produzieren wollen – unsere
**[Lohnabfüllung][44] **bietet Ihnen modernste Anlagen und ein umfassendes Servicepaket zu äußerst
wettbewerbsfähigen Preisen.

Zudem bietet unser erfahrenes Team umfassende Unterstützung bei der **Entwicklung **und Optimierung
Ihres Produkts für die Blow-Fill-Seal-Technologie.

## Your Skincare Concierge

Healthy skin starts with the right foundation. We stock a curated range of effective and trusted
medical-grade skincare, selected to support every skin type and concern. Our products are chosen for
their proven results, high-quality ingredients and ability to support skin health.

[ Shop Now ][166]

## How Skin Pharmacy Works

[ Speak to an Expert ][167]
[Speak With A Skin Expert]
Step One

#### Speak With A Skin Expert

Our skin experts provide in-depth consultations to understand your individual skincare needs and
goals. We offer personalised recommendations and ensure the safe use of medical-grade products
(*consultation required for some products).

[Personalise your Routine]
Step Two

#### Personalise your Routine

Designed just for you. We create a personalised plan targeting your specific concerns. No more
confusion – our skin experts build a routine that is precisely aligned with your skin’s needs.

[Receive Your Products]
Step Three

#### Receive Your Products

A few clicks and your order is on its way! Enjoy speedy options like Same Day Delivery or Next Day
Delivery. Free delivery applies to UK orders over £100. See full details on Shipping & Delivery
[here][168].

## Got Questions? We've Got Answers

Find answers to the most common questions about our products and services. Can't find what you're
looking for? Contact our support team.

### What is medical-grade skincare? 

Medical-grade skincare contains high-strength active ingredients backed by clinical research.
Designed to treat specific skin concerns, medical-grade products penetrate deeper than standard
skincare and are typically recommended by professionals for optimal results.

### Is medical-grade skincare better than over-the-counter products? 

Medical-grade skincare offers higher-strength ingredients and deeper results, making it more
effective for treating specific concerns than most over-the-counter products.

### Do I need a prescription for medical-grade skincare?

Not always. Many medical-grade products are available without a prescription but are best used under
professional guidance for safety and effectiveness. [Book a FREE consultation with one of our
skincare experts][196] for advice and recommendations.

## [**Taj Pharmaceuticals**][121], is a [generics pharmaceuticals company][122] with product range
## exceeding 4600 compositions under all therapeutic categories

Taj Pharmaceuticals Limited stands at the forefront of healthcare innovation and compassion. Our
commitment to improving lives is unwavering, as evidenced by our extensive range of pharmaceutical
offerings. We proudly supply prescription solutions, life-saving medications, anti-cancer
treatments, veterinary care products, trusted consumer brands, and cutting-edge CNS drugs.

Our focus extends to a wide spectrum of health concerns, including anemia, anxiety disorders, cancer
and oncology, ear infections, heart failure, hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, influenza, non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma,
obesity, osteoporosis, Parkinson’s disease, pneumonia, transplantation, and various common ailments.

With our headquarters nestled in the vibrant city of Mumbai, India, Taj Pharmaceuticals India
Business continues to lead the way in providing healthcare solutions that empower individuals and
communities to thrive. Join us on our journey towards a healthier, brighter future.

Taj Pharmaceuticals stands proudly as a global leader in generics, ranking among the top ten
pharmaceutical companies in India. Our legacy in the field of medicine spans over a century, and our
commitment to innovation and excellence shines through. We have taken the forefront in critical
therapeutic areas such as cancer, virology, and transplantation. What sets us apart is the
harmonious fusion of Taj Pharma’s generic and pharmaceutical divisions, backed by cutting-edge
genetic sciences, allowing us to craft personalized healthcare solutions tailored precisely to
individual patient needs.

At Taj Pharmaceuticals, our mission is clear – to alleviate suffering and elevate the quality of
life for people worldwide. We have tirelessly pursued this noble goal with unwavering patience,
dedication, imagination, and expertise. Our vision revolves around the creation of targeted
medicines and diagnostic tools, uniting to provide patients, physicians, and payers with superior,
safer, and more cost-effective healthcare solutions.

Welcome to Taj Pharmaceuticals, where a profound vision transforms into reality. We are more than
just a company; we are pioneers in Innovating Generics Healthcare.

Taj Pharmaceuticals Limited operates with an unshakable commitment to earn the trust of doctors,
patients, and customers every single day. We understand that trust is a precious currency, and we
invest daily in becoming champions for our stakeholders.

Over the past decade, Taj Pharmaceuticals Group has been diligently shaping a new paradigm in
healthcare. Throughout our organization in India, we nurture enduring relationships founded on
mutual confidence. This commitment is evident in our actions – our scientists earn trust through
groundbreaking discoveries, our sales and marketing teams work tirelessly to improve global health,
and our colleagues at every level strive to be trustworthy.

This journey demands relentless effort, impeccable execution, unwavering integrity, and transparency
from all Taj Pharmaceuticals Group members. Our global team remains resolute in expanding innovative
treatments and increasing access to quality healthcare worldwide. We aspire to excellence in three
core areas: our people, our products, and our processes.

The fruits of our labor are beginning to emerge, but we believe the best is yet to come. True
champions never relent; they tirelessly pursue better outcomes. As a healthcare company, our purpose
is to help people worldwide live better and longer lives.

Our product range encompasses a wide array of major generic drugs, spanning therapeutic categories
such as anti-cancer drugs, CNS medications, and key medicines for conditions like anemia, anxiety
disorders, heart failure, hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, and more. Taj Pharmaceuticals is dedicated to
improving the human condition by providing effective solutions for common diseases and complex
medical challenges.

###  TAJ PHARMA MANUFACTURING

Our world class finished dosage manufacturing facility is located at At Village – Kalgam,Coastal
Highway Road,Dist. – Valsad, Gujrat – 396142.India in the middle of the some of the major generic
players of the world. The facility has dedicated manufacturing modules for oral solid dosages
Tablet, Capsule, Small Volume Parenterals, Injection, Dry Injection, Syrups & Suspensions ,
Ointments , Dry Syrups and caters to export and domestic markets.
* A Scale up and a Commercial module for Solid dosages
* Two Modules for Sterile manufacturing
* Class 10,000 and Class 1000 controlled conditions. 17 dedicated AHUs to control individual areas.
  Terminal Hepa filters in core processing area

Some of salient features of our facilities are
• Class 10,000 and Class 1000 controlled conditions. 17 dedicated AHUs to control individual areas.
Terminal Hepa filters in core processing area
• Capable of wet/dry granulation, direct compression, film coating and blister/strip/alu-alu packing
• The Purified Water Distribution loop confirming to USP only
• Comprehensive utilities (Boilers, Chilled & Hot water, Air compressors, H.T Electricity incl. DG
and UPS)
• GCs, HPLCs with PDA, UV Spectrophotometers, IR, PSD, DSC
• Absolute focus on Safety, Health & Environment
• Gearing up for ISO 9001 and 14001 (EMS) certifications
• Factory cGMP, WHO, UKMHRA Approved

### pharmaceutical products.

per shift Small Volume Parenterals 4.5 lac per shift Syrups & Suspensions 1.5 lac per shift

[[flask][flask]][123]State-of-the art Liquid Injections (SVP Line) and General Dry Powder
facilities, which adhere to stringent specifications of GMP and WHO-GMP; We are International
standard contract manufacturing Organization.

[[spinner][spinner]][124]Taj Pharma leverages its India units as cost effective manufacturing
together with its extensive expertise and technology platforms to offer competitive, high quality,
custom manufacturing services to a global clientele. Our facility has been inspected by various
international regulators including the USFDA, GMP, WHO & ISO Certified.

[[clock][clock]][125]Taj Pharma’s manufacturing facilities operate to the highest standards of
quality control. Tests produced at all four of our sites are manufactured to stringent levels of
reliability, reproducibility and stability.

## exceeding 4600 compositions under all therapeutic categories

Taj Pharmaceuticals Limited stands at the forefront of healthcare innovation and compassion. Our
commitment to improving lives is unwavering, as evidenced by our extensive range of pharmaceutical
offerings. We proudly supply prescription solutions, life-saving medications, anti-cancer
treatments, veterinary care products, trusted consumer brands, and cutting-edge CNS drugs.

Our focus extends to a wide spectrum of health concerns, including anemia, anxiety disorders, cancer
and oncology, ear infections, heart failure, hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, influenza, non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma,
obesity, osteoporosis, Parkinson’s disease, pneumonia, transplantation, and various common ailments.

With our headquarters nestled in the vibrant city of Mumbai, India, Taj Pharmaceuticals India
Business continues to lead the way in providing healthcare solutions that empower individuals and
communities to thrive. Join us on our journey towards a healthier, brighter future.

Taj Pharmaceuticals stands proudly as a global leader in generics, ranking among the top ten
pharmaceutical companies in India. Our legacy in the field of medicine spans over a century, and our
commitment to innovation and excellence shines through. We have taken the forefront in critical
therapeutic areas such as cancer, virology, and transplantation. What sets us apart is the
harmonious fusion of Taj Pharma’s generic and pharmaceutical divisions, backed by cutting-edge
genetic sciences, allowing us to craft personalized healthcare solutions tailored precisely to
individual patient needs.

At Taj Pharmaceuticals, our mission is clear – to alleviate suffering and elevate the quality of
life for people worldwide. We have tirelessly pursued this noble goal with unwavering patience,
dedication, imagination, and expertise. Our vision revolves around the creation of targeted
medicines and diagnostic tools, uniting to provide patients, physicians, and payers with superior,
safer, and more cost-effective healthcare solutions.

Welcome to Taj Pharmaceuticals, where a profound vision transforms into reality. We are more than
just a company; we are pioneers in Innovating Generics Healthcare.

Taj Pharmaceuticals Limited operates with an unshakable commitment to earn the trust of doctors,
patients, and customers every single day. We understand that trust is a precious currency, and we
invest daily in becoming champions for our stakeholders.

Over the past decade, Taj Pharmaceuticals Group has been diligently shaping a new paradigm in
healthcare. Throughout our organization in India, we nurture enduring relationships founded on
mutual confidence. This commitment is evident in our actions – our scientists earn trust through
groundbreaking discoveries, our sales and marketing teams work tirelessly to improve global health,
and our colleagues at every level strive to be trustworthy.

This journey demands relentless effort, impeccable execution, unwavering integrity, and transparency
from all Taj Pharmaceuticals Group members. Our global team remains resolute in expanding innovative
treatments and increasing access to quality healthcare worldwide. We aspire to excellence in three
core areas: our people, our products, and our processes.

The fruits of our labor are beginning to emerge, but we believe the best is yet to come. True
champions never relent; they tirelessly pursue better outcomes. As a healthcare company, our purpose
is to help people worldwide live better and longer lives.

Our product range encompasses a wide array of major generic drugs, spanning therapeutic categories
such as anti-cancer drugs, CNS medications, and key medicines for conditions like anemia, anxiety
disorders, heart failure, hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, and more. Taj Pharmaceuticals is dedicated to
improving the human condition by providing effective solutions for common diseases and complex
medical challenges.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What are medical grade skincare systems?

Medical grade skincare systems are coordinated routines built around high-performance active
ingredients to target specific skin concerns. Truth Treatments combines pharmacist-formulated
products into simple protocols designed to support healthier-looking skin without fillers or
unnecessary ingredients.

How is Truth Treatments different from over-the-counter skincare?

Truth Treatments uses 100% active and functional ingredients, lipid-based delivery, and
pharmacist-formulated skincare systems. Instead of water-heavy formulas with fillers and fragrance,
every ingredient is chosen to support skin health and visible results.

Why does Truth Treatments use THDA Vitamin C?

Truth Treatments uses THDA because it is a stable, lipid-soluble form of vitamin C designed to work
with the skin's natural barrier. It helps support brighter, firmer, healthier-looking skin while
being gentler than many traditional vitamin C formulas.

What order should I use Truth Treatments products?

Follow a simple routine: cleanse, prep, treat, moisturize, and apply sunscreen during the day. Using
Truth Treatments products in the recommended order helps maximize the performance of your skincare
system.

How long does it take to see results?

Many people notice improved hydration and radiance within a few weeks. More significant improvements
in skin tone, texture, and firmness typically develop with consistent daily use over time.

Are Truth Treatments skincare systems good for sensitive skin?

Yes. Truth Treatments offers skincare systems for sensitive, dry, and compromised skin, including
barrier-support formulas like Omega 6 Healing Cream. Start slowly and follow the recommended routine
for your skin type.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What are medical grade skincare systems?

Medical grade skincare systems are coordinated routines built around high-performance active
ingredients to target specific skin concerns. Truth Treatments combines pharmacist-formulated
products into simple protocols designed to support healthier-looking skin without fillers or
unnecessary ingredients.

How is Truth Treatments different from over-the-counter skincare?

Truth Treatments uses 100% active and functional ingredients, lipid-based delivery, and
pharmacist-formulated skincare systems. Instead of water-heavy formulas with fillers and fragrance,
every ingredient is chosen to support skin health and visible results.

Why does Truth Treatments use THDA Vitamin C?

Truth Treatments uses THDA because it is a stable, lipid-soluble form of vitamin C designed to work
with the skin's natural barrier. It helps support brighter, firmer, healthier-looking skin while
being gentler than many traditional vitamin C formulas.

What order should I use Truth Treatments products?

Follow a simple routine: cleanse, prep, treat, moisturize, and apply sunscreen during the day. Using
Truth Treatments products in the recommended order helps maximize the performance of your skincare
system.

How long does it take to see results?

Many people notice improved hydration and radiance within a few weeks. More significant improvements
in skin tone, texture, and firmness typically develop with consistent daily use over time.

Are Truth Treatments skincare systems good for sensitive skin?

Yes. Truth Treatments offers skincare systems for sensitive, dry, and compromised skin, including
barrier-support formulas like Omega 6 Healing Cream. Start slowly and follow the recommended routine
for your skin type.

July 16, 2026

### Making Peptide Purification Green without Forfeiting Productivity.

While green solvents like ethanol and DMC are better for the planet, they typically suffer from
lower chromatographic resolution in traditional setups. This has resulted in a trade-off of choosing
sustainability, or choosing high yield. The whitepaper Counter-Current Chromatography Enables Use of
Green Solvents for Productive Peptide Purification Processes shows how using Multi-column
Counter-current Solvent Gradient Purification (MCSGP) can overcome the inefficiencies of
eco-friendly mobile phases.
[Read More][99]

July 8, 2026

### Optimizing Liquid Chromatography for Vitamin Analysis

Vitamins play a critical role in human health, serving as precursors to vital coenzymes, supporting
metabolic pathways, and offering widespread benefits across the pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, and
cosmetic industries. However, analyzing water-soluble vitamins such as the B-complex group and
Vitamin C, presents unique challenges for analytical chemists.
[Read More][100]

June 18, 2026

### Happy Retirement, John!

Today, we are celebrating John Heffernan, who is officially stepping into retirement after 16 years
with YMC America. John’s journey with us actually began back when we were known as Integrated
Process Technologies, long before we transitioned to YMC America. Over the years, John has worn many
hats, from Project Manager to Estimating Manager, Engineering Manager, and ultimately Director of
Business Development.
[Read More][101]

June 2, 2026

### Chromatography of Biotherapeuticals – Analyzing and Purifying Peptides and Oligonucleotides

This webinar will highlight how advanced ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography (UHPLC)
strategies, carefully selected stationary phases, and bioinert hardware can significantly improve
the analysis and purification of peptides and oligonucleotides.
[Read More][102]

May 21, 2026

### Breaking Down mRNA Capping Efficiency with High-Resolution IP-RP LC

Evaluating 5' capping efficiency is a critical quality attribute in therapeutic mRNA manufacturing,
directly impacting translation efficiency and transcript stability. However, separating structurally
similar capped, partially capped, and uncapped species differing by just a single nucleotide remains
a significant chromatographic challenge.
[Read More][103]

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
